_note: Competitions whose shot charts the sync reads (data/shots/<match id>.json, one file per game) for the Shot map tab on player profiles. A competition still being played gets its charts as its games finish (sync.sync_comp); one added after its games were played is caught up by the catch-up pass in autosync/run.py (sync.shots_only: up to sync.SHOTS_BATCH chart pages a run, each checked against its box score's FGA). 2026-10-16: every competition from the MABA source, 2017 to 2026, except the NXT Championship (49720, 49721), on the owner's word; one game of each was probed and has a chart. Competitions from other sources (MILO Lum Mun Chak Cup 2018/19 and MSSM U18 2026 from hand imports and CBL, the FIBA youth events from FIBA LiveStats) have no chart here.
